description: A hospital operations administrator must assign the one portable bedside ultrasound machine for tomorrow night's clinical work and document the coverage plan for the unit that does not receive it, with input from the emergency department clinical lead and the ICU coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The hospital has one portable bedside ultrasound machine available for tomorrow's overnight shift.
shared_context.S2: The emergency department and ICU have both requested the machine for that shift.
shared_context.S3: Morgan makes the final equipment assignment and records the overnight coverage plan.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal overnight equipment huddle, Morgan checks with the emergency department lead and ICU coordinator before finalizing the assignment.
shared_context.S5: The coverage plan records the specific time window for the portable machine and any backup equipment used by the other unit.

PF1.text: The emergency department has a scheduled ultrasound-dependent procedure tomorrow from 22:00 to 23:00, and no other suitable ultrasound is available there during that hour; Leah confirmed the procedure time with the clinical team, but it has not yet been added to the equipment request.

PF2.text: The ICU's backup ultrasound unit, tagged ICU-2, will be available for the entire period from 21:00 to 01:00 after its battery inspection is completed, so the ICU can use ICU-2 if the portable machine is assigned elsewhere; Ravi received the engineering confirmation but it is not yet in the shared equipment log.

acceptance_conditions: The portable ultrasound must be assigned to the emergency department.
The recorded emergency-department use window must be exactly 22:00-23:00.
The ICU backup unit must be recorded as ICU-2.
A commitment must document ICU-2 coverage for the ICU from 21:00 to 01:00.
The emergency-department procedure fact must be cited as justification for the assignment.

content_checks.C4: any(c['type'] == 'icu_backup_coverage' and c['target'] == 'ICU' and ('21:00-01:00' in c['detail'] or '21:00 to 01:00' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The scheduled procedure changes the assignment to the emergency department and fixes the portable-machine window at exactly 22:00-23:00 instead of leaving either choice open.
The confirmed ICU-2 availability changes the ICU coverage plan from unspecified backup coverage to ICU-2 specifically from 21:00 to 01:00.
